cms_architectural_invariants.invariant: Decoupled Headless Contract: Storyblok owns zero HTML, CSS, or molecular components in production. It operates strictly as a decoupled JSON data store returning content arrays of typed bloks.

Zero Production Iframe: The application renders native Next.js Server Components. Iframes are strictly isolated to the Storyblok Visual Editor administrative preview (app.storyblok.com) via window.postMessage bridge listeners.
Presentation Sovereignty: All styling, fluid typography, WCAG 2.2 AA focus indicators, and layout constraints remain 100% under local Tailwind CSS v4 CSS-first token custody.

Offline CI Determinism: CI runners execute static generation and type audits against local fixture JSON, eliminating build-time network dependencies, API token exposure, and rate-limiting failure states.

SEO URL Invariance: Established public-facing URL routes (/who-we-are, /job-insights, /us-govt-financial-support, /self-care-tools) and nested article routes (/job-insights/:slug*) remain fixed at the routing layer via server-side rewrites and dynamic normalization in next.config.ts and page.tsx, regardless of internal Storyblok slug variations.

Application Widget Decoupling: Interactive functional interfaces (TabbedInterface search engine, MainNav dropdown menus, and contact form handlers) reside in native application code and are NOT treated as Storyblok CMS bloks.

Zero-Code Dynamic Page Ingestion: Any new page created in Storyblok using 'Standard Page' (or unmapped blok types via FallbackBlok) resolves dynamically via src/app/[[...slug]]/page.tsx across root and pages/ folder paths without requiring new Next.js route files.

level_1_guided_reconnaissance.description: Audits critical TJAP application flows (form submission, document upload, auth gates) using the Golden Schematic as a rigid RAG constraint to eliminate AI syntax drift and Playwright hallucinations.
level_1_guided_reconnaissance.verification_target: WCAG 2.2 AA / Section 508 compliance across static DOM structures and pre-approved user journeys.

level_2_autonomous_reconnaissance.description: Operates unconstrained under the Feral Grit Mandate, autonomously crawling dynamic routes to expose transitional popups, unannounced visual state changes, and focus traps that static DOM scanners miss.
level_2_autonomous_reconnaissance.verification_target: Real-time visual rendering traps and screen reader barriers across unscripted site paths.

level_1_passive_reconnaissance.description: Standard flow verification with strict schema validation and active listeners attached directly to Playwright page console and network traffic.
level_1_passive_reconnaissance.throttle_protocol: Intercepts HTTP 429 API Bouncer rate-limit errors, cooling down for 20 seconds with exponential backoff.

level_2_agitated_fuzzing.description: Adopts a brawler mentality—mutating form inputs, injecting unexpected character streams, and double-clicking submission buttons to stress asynchronous network states.

level_3_maximum_ferality.description: Agentic Override off-leash mode. Invents zero-day edge cases based on page context, analyzes intercepted network headers, and bypasses the visual frontend to fire malformed payloads directly at backend endpoints.

phase_4_sentinel_catch.description: Captures failure state screenshots (.png) and Playwright text logs upon execution faults, converting PNG artifacts into base64 image buffers for multimodal vision model evaluation.

negative_space_analysis.description: Analyzes total visual context to identify physical UI blockers (z-index traps, invisible overlays, loading spinners, low-contrast text) blocking the user experience.

phase_5_artifact_generation.description: Compiles April-Approved Artifacts—impeccably formatted bugtemplate.md reports detailing actual vs. expected behavior, impact on human OS flow, and direct local evidence file paths (trace.zip and PNGs).
